notes: Specimen dates are evidence of use, not verified first-use dates. No designer attribution established.

specimens.name: Solutions BC — early colour identity
specimens.date_basis: Cover letter on PDF page 1. Logo is on page 2. Same native JPEG also occurs in the payroll RFP dated October 9, 2003.
specimens.extraction: Original embedded JPEG extracted without re-encoding; PDF image xref 6; 115 x 149 pixels. Preview is a rendered enlargement and adds no source detail.

specimens.name: Solutions BC — provincial emblem letterhead
specimens.date_basis: Date printed on original government letter; hosted by BC Nature.
specimens.extraction: Rendered crop of original scan at 216 dpi; no redraw, cleanup or added detail.

specimens.name: Shared Services BC — early colour provincial signature
specimens.date_basis: Report title is November 2006; PDF document title says for posting July 2007 and PDF creation metadata is July 20, 2007. This supports a 2006/07 document specimen; exact logo first-use date is not proven.
specimens.extraction: Original embedded colour pixels, PDF image xref 75, with original transparency mask xref 74; 386 x 109 pixels. Separate preview rendered on original white page at 216 dpi. No tracing or recreation.

specimens.name: Shared Services BC — letterhead with provincial tagline
specimens.date_basis: Date printed on the letter in Appendix C, PDF page 12. The containing council report is dated April 15, 2011 and was considered May 3, 2011.
specimens.extraction: Rendered crop of original black-and-white scan at 216 dpi; no redraw, cleanup or added detail.

specimens.name: Shared Services BC — colour brochure signature
specimens.date_basis: PDF creation metadata. Brochure also refers to a service rollout in 2015. This is a source-document date, not a proven logo introduction date.
specimens.extraction: PNG rendered from original PDF at 216 dpi. Companion cropped PDF retains original vector paths and shading without tracing.
